artworks.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an existing transparent full-body game enemy. Image 2 is the STYLE AND MASK MATERIAL REFERENCE: the game's Ink Spirit, with an ancient cast bronze ritual fox/beast mask, ochre-bronze ridges, dark green patina, crisp ink outlines and red eye slits. Change ONLY the target's head/face area and neckline as needed to fully conceal the human face. Fit a solid opaque full-face ancient bronze beast mask over the ENTIRE face from forehead through chin and around the sides. No visible human skin on face, no human eyes, lips, nose, ears or facial hair sticking out. Replace exposed ears with dark hood/wrap shadows, and exposed neck with dark high collar/wrap, while retaining the original head angle, head center, hairstyle silhouette and hat/headband. The mask should feel like the same in-world family as Ink Spirit's mask, with cast engraved brow ridges, stylized animal muzzle, small red-lit eye slits in black recesses, worn ochre bronze and restrained green patina, flat hard-edged hand-inked rendering, no glossy photoreal metal. Keep mask modest and fitted to the original head, no oversized added halo, no giant horns. Preserve ALL other artwork, complete pose, body silhouette, clothing folds/colors, hands and fingers, props, full canvas framing and aspect ratio as closely as possible. It remains one full-body enemy asset ready to use with the same animation rig. Keep TRUE transparent alpha background, including outside silhouette; absolutely no background/vignette/glow/ground plane/shadow/text/border. User requirement: no human face showing; bronze full-face mask like Ink Spirit. Character-specific instruction: Lean bent ledger merchant. A narrow fox-beast bronze mask, sly slanted red slits, small cast pointed chin plate replacing the human goatee. Keep scholar cap, account backpack, ledger and open palm.
